## Key decisions made this session
- **Dynamic `import()` doesn't work in `vscode-webview://`** — confirmed limitation, disabled esbuild splitting
- **Mermaid loaded as separate IIFE bundle** via async `<script>` tag, matching canonical vscode-markdown-mermaid pattern
- **`unsafe-eval` required in CSP** — mermaid's dependency tree uses `Function("return this")` for global resolution
- **`external: ['fs']` in mermaid IIFE build** — mermaid has a `require('fs')` in its tree that crashes in browser
- **`ignoreMutation` on ProseMirror node view** — the root cause of all rendering failures. ProseMirror's DOMObserver was intercepting mermaid SVG injection and reverting/crashing. Must be set on any node view that does async DOM updates.
- **Shiki removed for now** — dynamic import broken, static import bloats bundle (1.8MB gzipped). Needs separate IIFE bundle or `shiki/core` with JS engine approach. Code blocks fall back to plain escaped text.
